title: Announcing the 2026 Open Neuromorphic Executive Committee
summary: Open Neuromorphic announced its new 2026 Executive Committee on 2026-02-22. The incoming team includes Justin Riddiough as Chair, focusing on platform stability and financial sustainability; Alexandre Marcireau as Vice-Chair for scientific integrity in event-based vision; and Effiong Blessing as Secretary Chair for community engagement and educational pipelines like 'Zero to Silicon'. The committee's mandate is to flatten the organizational structure from a hierarchical model to one based on collaborative areas of responsibility. They aim to update the Organisational Charter, distribute decision-making by domain expertise, and launch benchmarking competitions with partners such as Project PHASOR.
tldr: Open Neuromorphic elected its 2026 Executive Committee to transition governance toward a flatter structure focused on open-source infrastructure stability and scientific rigor in neuromorphic computing.
evidence: The 2026 Executive Committee Chair: Justin Riddiough ... He plans to focus on ensuring the stability and scalability of ONM's platforms
Vice-Chair: Alexandre Marcireau ... As a respected researcher in the event-based vision space, he will focus on scientific integrity and quality control.
Secretary Chair: Effiong Blessing is a PhD candidate in Computer Science specializing in neuromorphic computing and brain-inspired AI. Her work sits at the intersection of spiking neural networks
The new committee has already begun work on several key initiatives discussed during the transition: - Educational Pipelines ... Open Source Advocacy ... Community Competitions
